test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: e-NAM launched by the Government of India in April 2016 is:

options.text: the name of a national electronic market
an electronic platform for agriculture market
an electronic registration for business establishments' names
a national portal for e-commerce activities

solution:
The correct answer is __**an electronic platform for agriculture market**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **e-NAM** stands for National Agriculture Market.
 
• It is an **electronic platform** launched by the Government of India in April 2016.
 
• e-NAM aims to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities by integrating existing Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) markets across the country.</
